name: The Beauty Tech Group plc
summary: The Beauty Tech Group plc operates globally as a specialist in at-home beauty technology, with its offerings reaching consumers in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, the European Union, and Asia. The company handles the full lifecycle of its products, from development and manufacturing to direct retail of personal beauty devices. Its portfolio features devices harnessing advanced techniques like LED light, radiofrequency (RF), microcurrent, and laser therapies. Under the CurrentBody Skin brand, it markets LED light therapy and RF technology products directly to consumers via online channels. The ZIIP Beauty brand further expands its offerings with skincare formulations and innovative facial toning devices. Additionally, the Tria Laser brand specializes in at-home laser hair removal solutions. Founded in 2009, this Macclesfield, United Kingdom-based company was previously named Lunessa plc, adopting its current identity, The Beauty Tech Group plc, in September 2025.
